title: esphome-yaml #128 Voice Pyramid 灯组件在 ESPHome 2026.11.x 编译失败

execution.environment: macOS host; ESPHome 2026.11.1 and 2026.10.0 venvs, ESP-IDF 5.5.6; local Device Service QEMU profiles atoms3r and cores3

checks.name: build_esphome_2026_11_1_unpatched
checks.detail: Component head 61b5ecbb fails with the two errors reported in the issue: get_view_internal marked override but does not override; brace-init cannot convert to light::ESPColorView

checks.name: build_esphome_2026_10_0_unpatched
checks.detail: Same config and component head compile on ESPHome 2026.10.0, matching the reporter's comparison

checks.name: build_esphome_2026_11_1_patched
checks.detail: Reference patch using CorrectedBufferColorAccessor and ChannelColors{2,1,0} compiles on 2026.11.1; ELF no longer defines get_view_internal

checks.name: build_esphome_2026_10_0_patched
checks.detail: Version gate keeps the legacy path; ELF still defines get_view_internal and has no accessor symbols

checks.name: version_gate_header
checks.detail: Generated build version.h is 2026.11.1 / 2026.10.0 respectively, not the 2099.12.0 source stub

checks.name: upstream_change_attribution
checks.detail: esphome/esphome#21577 (merged 2026-10-31, first shipped in 2026.11.0) removed get_view_internal and the six-pointer ESPColorView constructor

checks.name: virtual_device_boot
checks.detail: Runtime firmware only reached the 226-byte ROM/bootloader banner on atoms3r and cores3 profiles; atoms3r session failed with serial marker timeout, so no accessor pixel dump could be collected

checks.name: pyramid_rgb_controller_model
checks.detail: No profile models the Voice Pyramid I2C 0x1A RGB controller; writes would NAK even if the guest booted

checks.name: physical_hardware_led_output
checks.detail: No AtomS3R + Voice Pyramid hardware available; LED color order, brightness, audio and touch not observed

checks.name: full_factory_yaml_build
checks.detail: Only the light component was isolated for reproduction; lp5562, aw87559, si5351, m5_atoms3_voice_ui and esphome-audio-stack were not individually verified on 2026.11.1

notes: Fix belongs to m5stack/esphome feat-voice-pyramid (component), not to this YAML repository.
m5stack/esphome@m5-dev still carries old-style AddressableLight subclasses (m5ioe1, m5_unit_extio2); the m5stack_ioe1 rename in commit 8ba135cd is the migrated counterpart.
Reference patch proves compile compatibility only; channel order still needs confirmation on hardware.
Workaround for users: stay on ESPHome 2026.10.x until the component branch is migrated.
